title: The pen
logline: The pen, close, on the drafting table: the brush-pen from 2004's Sundays, refilled a thousand times, the barrel worn to the metal where three fingers go. The page draws the wear as the years.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of a brush pen lying on a drafting table, its barrel worn through to bare metal in three places where fingers hold it, ink on the paper beneath.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an extreme close-up of a brush pen lying on a drafting table with its barrel worn through to bare metal in three places where fingers hold it, ink on the paper beneath, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
